body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> LG introduced its new enV phone during 2007 CES Unveiled.
This entertainment device features a 2.0 megapixel camera/camcorder with autofocus and lens cover, a QWERTY keyboard, and a dual stereo speakers.
It has launched to US market last December.
